cells.gaps: The BCC joined PAPSS about a month before 21 October 2026, but DRC banks and fintechs were only then invited to apply and no transaction can pass until they connect (COD-005), so the country is not live on PAPSS; joining does not count.
cells.note: The BCC oversees Switch Mosolo, the national card switch, which microfinance institutions began joining in April 2026. No regional system in service has been found; PAPSS accession with no live participation is not counted. The BCC's map of the national payment system lists the e-money issuers and other payment providers it has approved (COD-004).
